title: Playing for the Delta Line ship sailings
summary: The band plays three to four on alternate Mondays for Delta Line departures; schedules, boat names and winter cold are discussed.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Are you still playing for the boat when the boat leaves every two weeks?
Yes, we were there Monday. We were there Monday. We played there Monday, yeah.
I thought they used to play on, I used to, I thought the boat was... Used to play on Thursdays.

On Thursdays. That's right. But the boat go, schedule is different now. Oh. It used to leave Houston and come here and go to South America. Night leaves from here and goes to Houston. Ah. You see? And then it goes south. And it's sailed from Houston to South America. Ah, I see. So it made a difference in the schedule, so that made, we get a different day now. We played on Mondays. And we used to play two to three on Thursdays. Now we play three to four on Mondays. Oh, that's right. Three to four on Mondays every two weeks. About every two weeks.
Sometimes every three weeks. It all depends. Sometimes every two weeks for quite a while then.

Looks like the boat will be a week later. Yeah, for a while. Yeah. Just talking to Albert today about the boat. You know. That was a pretty good boat. It didn't sail away until about six o'clock. I met one of the fellows that works. He's a pretty good boat. He's a pretty good boat. It didn't sail away until about six o'clock. I met one of the fellows that works. He's a pretty good boat. He's a head of all those boys that carried the suitcases and the grips and all on the boat. Well, he's a head of them. I met him the other day and he said the boat didn't sail until six o'clock. Now, one time ago they would let us play until the boat was sailed, but it was taking so long to load it, so he figured we'd have to play too long. So he decided to play that whole hour and call it quits. So that's what we've been doing and sail.
You starting at what time is it? Three to four. Three to four.
Three to four, yeah. About every other Monday?

About every other Monday. But you could look on the newspaper. Either the Delmore, the Del Sud, or the Del Nauti. Either one of those three boats, if you see where they're going to sail that Monday. That's the Delta Line.
The Delta Line. Yes. Delmore, the Delta, the Del Nauti.
Of course, it's not so bad in this warm weather, but in that cold weather, it gets kind of cold, doesn't it, when you're playing there?
Oh, man, oh, gee, we should've kept standing in the wintertime.
You're playing the old guys over there.

I'll be, it'll be cold on that wall. Yeah. The boys be saying, well boys, put on your hippies. Put some paper in your shoes. Yeah, because they said, that ride is going to be a little warm, a little cold, you know. It'll be nice out there.
